$comment: Generated-asset registry for heymate-onboarding (universe: Afterburn City). Champion models are USER-PROVIDED generated GLBs (Meshy-style 'base_basic_pbr.glb' exports from /Users/admin/Downloads/<Character Name>/), optimized via scripts/optimize-glb.mjs (dedup+prune, textures -> KTX2/BasisU (baseColor 2K, normal/ORM 1K, emissive 512), 35% mesh simplify, Meshopt; ~39MB -> ~3.3MB each). They load as immutable presentation-ready champions. The customizable Mate and the ambience remain procedural proxies so every customization control stays real.

characters.source: user-provided generated models, optimized by scripts/optimize-glb.mjs (KTX2/BasisU + Meshopt, native gltfpack)

faction-environments.source: user-provided generated 360 panoramas (hdr_high.png), resized 8192x4096 -> 4096x2048 WebP q80
faction-environments.note: Applied as equirectangular skybox + scene.environment per selected faction (src/three/backdrop.ts). Source EXR HDRs kept in Downloads if true HDR IBL is wanted later.
